description:
## Why

PKIX-amgn.8 vendor-zlint pattern requires the zlint source (for testdata corpus access useful to PKIX-hbzo.1) and the runnable binary (for 'zlint -listLintsJSON' invocation by the refresh tool). Mark chose BOTH paths 2026-05-11.

## What

1. Shallow clone github.com/zmap/zlint into ~/GIT/zlint:
   ```
   git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zmap/zlint ~/GIT/zlint
   ```
2. Install the binary:
   ```
   go install github.com/zmap/zlint/v3/cmd/zlint@latest
   ```
   The binary lands in $GOPATH/bin (or $HOME/go/bin). Confirm it's on PATH.
3. Verify both:
   - `ls ~/GIT/zlint/v3/lints/ | head` shows the lint Go source files.
   - `zlint -listLintsJSON | head -50` emits structured lint metadata.
   - `ls ~/GIT/zlint/v3/testdata/` shows the per-lint cert fixture corpus.

## Acceptance

- [ ] ~/GIT/zlint exists with depth-1 clone of master.
- [ ] zlint binary on PATH (`which zlint` succeeds).
- [ ] `zlint -listLintsJSON` runs and produces JSON output.
- [ ] testdata/ directory accessible (deferred consumer: PKIX-hbzo.1).

## Out of scope

- Pinning zlint to a specific commit (per amgn.8 decision: track master, refresh at maintainer's discretion).
- Writing the JSON-transform refresh tool (PKIX-amgn.8.3).

## Filed by

Decomposed from PKIX-amgn.8 per Mark's 2026-05-11 decisions.
title: Local zlint setup: shallow clone to ~/GIT/zlint + go install binary
